exposure: planned elective induction of labour (eIOL) at 39(0/7) to 39(6/7) weeks
cohort: 304 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies undergoing elective induction of labor at 39(0/7) to 39(6/7) weeks, with no plan for caesarean section (CS) or contraindication for vaginal delivery
finding: Induction of labor at 39 weeks in low-risk nulliparous women did not result in a lower frequency of CS or adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Induction of labor at 39 weeks in low-risk nulliparous women did not result in a lower frequency of cesarean section.
